native_mechanisms: Nightingales always land first on the unlocked stone bearing the smallest owed letter (extract-min over a frontier of tentative distances).
Threads cast from the tower price each road by its thief's toll, one direction at a time (directed, per-arc non-negative edge weights, never mirrored).

A landed stone's letter is locked permanently and never rebuilt; threads reaching nowhere are dropped and those stones keep their unreadable debt (settled nodes are final, unreachable stay at infinity).
A cast thread can be detached and recast toward the same stone with a lower number so the bird changes its mind (decrease-key in place on the existing frontier entry).
Chalking the far stone's letter over with the smaller sum plus a back-mark naming the stone the thread came from (relaxation with predecessor tracking).
core_technique: Standard single-source Dijkstra on a CSR-built directed graph using a 4-ary min-heap with in-place decrease-key, plus generic micro-optimisations (cache-line-aligned heap, prefetching, interleaved edge payload) and an inert dead-code back-walk.
